query:
SELECT
  segments.message,
  segments.ordinal,
  segments.body
FROM
  segments
  JOIN messages ON messages.uuid = segments.message
WHERE
  messages.author = ?1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      structured
    WHERE
      structured.message = segments.message
      AND structured.ordinal = segments.ordinal
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      flailed
    WHERE
      flailed.message = segments.message
      AND flailed.ordinal = segments.ordinal
  )
ORDER BY
  messages.at,
  segments.message,
  segments.ordinal
